verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an API-driven identity platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an interactive API explorer or runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the llms.txt, MCP server and CLI evidence covers different capabilities that do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
